patternPolicy: Counter suffixes, prefixes, attached expressions and annotated grammatical patterns are outside the standalone headword deck. Each row remains visible as pattern-not-headword in the ledger, not automatically covered. Useful counters and forms require contextual instruction and sound-change practice; course completion never certifies exhaustive N5/N4 coverage.
